newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAFMARINE FORMS SAFRICA, CHINA TRADE DESK.
newsitem.headline: SAFMARINE FORMS SAFRICA, CHINA TRADE DESK.

text.p: Safmarine had established a "China desk" to handle growing trade with the People's Republic of China, it said in a statement on Thursday.

The desk, initiated by the company's Saferoute/Trutainer unit based in Cape Town, would provide extensive port coverage throughout mainland China, serving Southern Africa, West Africa, East Africa, the Indian Ocean islands and the east coast of South America.
The move had largely been prompted by the recently formed partnership between Safmarine, which is part of the listed Safmarine and Rennies Ltd group, and Phoenix Shipping.
Phoenix managing director Duncan Davies said his group had been operating a specialised breakbulk service between the northern ports of Xingang and Dalian to Durban.
"(It) seemed logical to offer our deck capacity to Safmarine for container shipments," Davies said.
